successors.name: Anuradhapura Kingdom
successors.text: the coast and hinterland of present-day Puttalam: the landing 'near modern-day Mannar' (which the page takes to be the district of Chilaw), the first capital Tambapanni 'in present-day Puttalam' and…

ledger.x: 543 BCE: Prince Vijaya lands in Lanka and founds the Kingdom of Tambapanni.

c. 505 BCE: the seat moves north to Upatissagama. The Upatissa Nuwara page (opened for this) says Upatissagama was 'the second capital' and 'established by Upatissa, a follower and senior minister of Vijaya', and gives no date; -505 is Upatissa's accession on the Tambapanni infobox.
437 BCE: the kingdom's seat moves to Anuradhapura.

certainty.note: A kingdom of the chronicle tradition; the pages name capitals and a landing place, not a boundary.
